text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Special Week...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Over there! It's a claw machine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look in the direction Special Week is
pointing
and see a claw machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, wow! You know you're out
of the
sticks when you find merchandise
like this!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
How nice... I bet my mom would be
happy if I sent
her one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's eyes are sparkling
brighter than
diamonds...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
